description:
This is a sources sought notice only. No synopsis or solicitation are being issued at this time. The amount of information available for publication is currently limited. This notice is also for the purpose of market research in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 10.

Please provide any sources that may be able to manufacture the NSN listed below. All of the item’s technical data can be accessed in the cFolders (https://pcf1x.bsm.dla.mil/cfolders/) using project number “CL25345001”. All information may be submitted to Kelly Nicklaus by email at Kelly.nicklaus@dla.mil. All deliveries will be made to DLA Depots. Any information must be provided by the response date on this notification.

NSN 5330-01-209-5997

1G item     

Seal, Nonmetallic Strip

The drawings are available directly from cFolders by doing a query for CL25345001 and/or MR012095997 in the Solicitation field.
